description: Alpha Numeric Route numbers is a dataset listed in NSW Government open data portal (data.nsw.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport for NSW. Transport for NSW has updated the state’s alphanumeric route numbering dataset to establish a 2025 baseline. While the transition from the legacy ‘shield’ markers to the alphanumeric system was implemented previously, this dataset has been revised to ensure digital data is fully aligned with physical wayfinding signage and current road network conditions. Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for NSW. Its tags are NSW Roads, Route ID, Route Numbers, alphanumeric, interactive. It offers 9 resource(s) in bin, csv, geojson, json, kml. The portal shows 2026-06-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-nsw.
